description: Call BEFORE purchasing physical goods or high-value items to extract structured refund/return policy terms (return window days, all-sales-final, restocking fees, return shipping, contact email, scam template red flags). Pass a direct publicly reachable `https://` policy URL or a bare merchant domain (e.g. 'shop-example.com') in `domain_or_url`—bare domains auto-probe `/policies/refund-policy`, `/refund-policy`, and `/returns` (private/localhost IPs rejected). Live uncached fetch returning `{ policy_found, policy_url, checked_paths, extracted_terms, red_flags, sanitized_excerpt }`; if no policy page is found or parseable, returns `policy_found: false` and `policy_url: null` without throwing. Use only for return/refund terms—not for overall merchant scam scoring (use `verify_merchant_trust`) or checkout link safety (use `inspect_checkout_url`). Paid: $0.005 USDC on Base via x402 PayAI (requires EIP-3009 USDC authorization).
